title: Collateral Terms
description: collateral-terms/v1 — the terms document carried in Agreement.terms for a collateral agreement, base64-encoded on the wire and identified by Agreement.termsType. Part of the co-signed contract zone, so it cannot be changed by an amendment.

eligibleAsset.description: One asset the receiver accepts as collateral.

haircut.description: Valuation discount applied to this asset, as a fraction (0.02 = 2%). Absent means no haircut.

caip19.description: CAIP-19 identifier of the on-chain asset, when the eligible asset is chain-native.

baseCurrency.description: Currency the report nominals are expressed in, e.g. USD.

eligibleAssets.description: The eligible collateral set. An empty or absent list means the agreement declares no eligibility constraint.
